AI.title_translation: 你的超分辨率模型不足以应对现实世界场景
AI.tldr: 为解决传统SISR模型泛化到任意尺度困难的问题，本文提出了一个可插拔的尺度感知注意力模块（SAAM）。SAAM结合了SimAM和梯度损失，能将现有固定模型高效改造为支持任意尺度超分，并在多种SOTA骨干网络上实现了优越且计算开销极小的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的单图像超分辨率（SISR）模型难以泛化到不同的尺度因子，限制了它们在现实世界场景中的实际应用能力。
AI.method: 提出一个可插拔的尺度感知注意力模块（SAAM）。SAAM采用轻量级、尺度自适应的特征提取和上采样，集成了简单无参数注意力模块（SimAM）进行高效指导，并利用梯度方差损失来增强图像细节的清晰度。该模块可无缝集成到现有的SOTA SR骨干网络（如SCNet、HiT-SR、OverNet）中。
AI.result: 在广泛的整数和非整数尺度因子上，该方法提供了有竞争力或更优越的性能。实验证明，该方法能够以最小的计算开销实现鲁棒的多尺度上采样。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法实现了鲁棒的多尺度上采样，且计算开销极小，为现实世界场景提供了一个实用的超分辨率解决方案。
AI.translation: 尽管单图像超分辨率（SISR）取得了显著进展，但传统的模型往往难以泛化到不同的尺度因子，限制了它们的现实世界适用性。为解决此问题，我们提出了一个可插拔的尺度感知注意力模块（SAAM），旨在将现代固定尺度的SR模型改造为能够执行任意尺度SR的能力。SAAM采用轻量级的、尺度自适应的特征提取和上采样，并结合了简单无参数注意力模块（SimAM）进行高效指导，以及梯度方差损失来增强图像细节的清晰度。我们的方法可无缝集成到多个最先进的SR骨干网络中（例如SCNet、HiT-SR、OverNet），在广泛的整数和非整数尺度因子上均提供了有竞争力或更优的性能。基准数据集上的广泛实验证明，我们的方法能够实现鲁棒的多尺度上采样，且计算开销极小，为现实世界场景提供了一个实用的解决方案。
AI.summary: 针对传统SISR模型难以泛化到不同尺度因子的局限性，本文提出了一个可插拔的尺度感知注意力模块（SAAM）。SAAM通过轻量级的尺度自适应特征提取和上采样，并结合SimAM和梯度方差损失，旨在将固定尺度的SR模型改造为能够支持任意尺度超分辨率。该方法可轻松集成到现有SOTA骨干网络中，在多种尺度因子上均表现出卓越性能，并以极小的计算开销提供了实用的多尺度上采样解决方案。
AI.keywords: 单图像超分辨率, 尺度感知注意力模块, 任意尺度SR, SimAM, 梯度方差损失
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个轻量级、可插拔的尺度感知注意力模块（SAAM），有效解决了现有SISR模型在应对任意尺度超分辨率时泛化能力差的核心局限性。通过将SAAM无缝集成到多个最先进的SR骨干网络中，它极大地提高了这些模型在现实世界场景中的实用性，同时保持了极低的计算开销。SAAM结合了尺度自适应特征提取、无参数注意力模块（SimAM）和梯度方差损失，确保了高效且高质量的多尺度上采样，具有重要的实际部署价值。

title: Trace Repair Never Loses to Classical Repair: Exact and Explicit Helper Nodes Selection
summary: Repairing Reed-Solomon codes with low bandwidth is a central challenge in distributed storage. Following the trace-repair framework of Guruswami and Wootters (2017), recent works by Lin (2023) and Liu-Wan-Xing (2024) provided significant improvements in bandwidth using two distinct ideas. Lin constructed a trace-repair scheme that requires no contribution from a set of predetermined nodes $\mathscr{S}$, while Liu-Wan-Xing identified linear dependencies among the downloaded traces, relating the number of dependent traces to the dimension of a subspace $\mathscr{W}_k$. In this work, we fully utilize and unify these ideas. We compute the exact dimension of $\mathscr{W}_{k,\mathscr{S}}$ (a generalization of $\mathscr{W}_k$). We identify the trade-off between the set size $|\mathscr{S}|$ and the dimension $\dim(\mathscr{W}_{k,\mathscr{S}})$. We provide an algorithm to find the combination that results in the lowest bandwidth. Furthermore, we provide an explicit choice of the helper nodes for the repair. Finally, we prove that our optimized scheme never loses to the classical repair scheme, establishing a bandwidth guarantee of at most $k\log|\mathbb{F}|$ bits for all dimension $k$ and field $\mathbb{F}$, whenever the trace repair is applicable.

AI.title_translation: 轨迹修复永远不逊于经典修复：精确且明确的辅助节点选择
AI.tldr: 本文统一并推广了现有的轨迹修复方法，通过精确计算和选择辅助节点，设计出一种优化方案，该方案保证了最低带宽，并且证明其性能永远不逊于经典修复，带宽上限为 $k\log|\mathbb{F}|$ 比特。
AI.motivation: 在分布式存储中，以低带宽修复Reed-Solomon码是一个核心挑战。近期工作已通过轨迹修复框架显著改善了带宽，但仍有优化的空间，需要统一并充分利用现有最佳思路来进一步降低带宽。
AI.method: 本文统一并充分利用了Lin和Liu-Wan-Xing的轨迹修复优化思路。具体方法包括：1. 计算广义子空间 $\mathscr{W}_{k,\mathscr{S}}$ 的精确维度。2. 确定非贡献节点集 $|\mathscr{S}|$ 和维度 $\dim(\mathscr{W}_{k,\mathscr{S}})$ 之间的权衡关系。3. 提供一种算法来找到产生最低带宽的最佳组合。4. 提供了修复所需的辅助节点的明确选择。
AI.result: 证明了优化的方案永远不逊于经典修复方案。建立了带宽保证，即在轨迹修复适用时，对于所有维度 $k$ 和域 $\mathbb{F}$，带宽最多为 $k\log|\mathbb{F}|$ 比特。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过统一和推广现有思想，设计出一种优化的轨迹修复方案，该方案通过精确选择辅助节点，保证了在所有适用情况下，其性能至少与经典修复方案持平，并给出了明确的带宽上界，即最多为 $k\log|\mathbb{F}|$ 比特。
AI.translation: 在分布式存储中，以低带宽修复Reed-Solomon码是一个核心挑战。遵循Guruswami和Wootters（2017）的轨迹修复框架，Lin（2023）和Liu-Wan-Xing（2024）的近期工作利用两种不同的思路显著改善了带宽。Lin构建了一种轨迹修复方案，该方案不需要预定节点集 $\mathscr{S}$ 的任何贡献，而Liu-Wan-Xing则识别了下载轨迹之间的线性依赖关系，将依赖轨迹的数量与子空间 $\mathscr{W}_k$ 的维度联系起来。在这项工作中，我们充分利用并统一了这些思想。我们计算了 $\mathscr{W}_{k,\mathscr{S}}$（$\mathscr{W}_k$ 的推广）的精确维度。我们确定了集合大小 $|\mathscr{S}|$ 和维度 $\dim(\mathscr{W}_{k,\mathscr{S}})$ 之间的权衡。我们提供了一种算法来找到产生最低带宽的组合。此外，我们为修复提供了辅助节点的明确选择。最后，我们证明了我们优化的方案永远不逊于经典修复方案，从而建立了带宽保证：只要轨迹修复适用，对于所有维度 $k$ 和域 $\mathbb{F}$，带宽最多为 $k\log|\mathbb{F}|$ 比特。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决Reed-Solomon码的低带宽修复挑战，通过统一并扩展先前的轨迹修复框架。作者计算了广义子空间 $\mathscr{W}_{k,\mathscr{S}}$ 的精确维度，分析了非贡献节点集 $|\mathscr{S}|$ 与维度之间的权衡，并提供了一种用于实现最低带宽的算法以及明确的辅助节点选择。该优化方案被证明性能永远不逊于经典修复方案，确保了在适用条件下的带宽上限为 $k\log|\mathbb{F}|$ 比特。
AI.keywords: 轨迹修复, Reed-Solomon码, 低带宽, 辅助节点选择, 分布式存储
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于统一并推广了现有的两种轨迹修复优化思路（Lin的无贡献节点集和Liu-Wan-Xing的线性依赖分析）。通过计算广义子空间的精确维度并分析权衡，作者实现了理论上的完全优化。更重要的是，该工作从理论分析迈向了实际应用，提供了一种显式选择辅助节点的算法，确保了最低带宽。其核心贡献是建立了强大的性能保证，即该优化方案的性能永远不逊于经典修复方案，为分布式存储中的RS码修复提供了坚实的理论和实践基础。

title: Continuous Audio Language Models
summary: Audio Language Models (ALM) have emerged as the dominant paradigm for speech and music generation by representing audio as sequences of discrete tokens. Yet, unlike text tokens, which are invertible, audio tokens are extracted from lossy codecs with a limited bitrate. As a consequence, increasing audio quality requires generating more tokens, which imposes a trade-off between fidelity and computational cost. We address this issue by studying Continuous Audio Language Models (CALM). These models instantiate a large Transformer backbone that produces a contextual embedding at every timestep. This sequential information then conditions an MLP that generates the next continuous frame of an audio VAE through consistency modeling. By avoiding lossy compression, CALM achieves higher quality at lower computational cost than their discrete counterpart. Experiments on speech and music demonstrate improved efficiency and fidelity over state-of-the-art discrete audio language models, facilitating lightweight, high-quality audio generation. Samples are available at hf.co/spaces/kyutai/calm-samples. Finally, we release Pocket TTS, an open-source 100M-parameter text-to-speech model that can run faster than real time on a laptop CPU: github.com/kyutai-labs/pocket-tts.

AI.tldr: 现有的离散音频语言模型（ALM）在保真度和计算成本之间存在权衡。本文提出了连续音频语言模型（CALM），它使用Transformer和MLP直接生成音频VAE的连续帧，避免了有损压缩，从而以更低的计算成本实现了更高的音频质量。同时发布了开源的Pocket TTS模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频语言模型（ALM）使用离散代币表示音频，这些代币是从有限比特率的有损编解码器中提取的。这导致了保真度与计算成本之间的权衡：提高音频质量需要生成更多的代币，从而增加了计算负担。
AI.method: 提出了连续音频语言模型（CALM）。这些模型包含一个大型Transformer主干网络，用于在每个时间步生成上下文嵌入。然后，该序列信息调节一个MLP，通过一致性建模生成音频VAE的下一个连续帧，从而避免了有损压缩。
AI.result: CALM比离散对应模型以更低的计算成本实现了更高的质量。在语音和音乐上的实验表明，其效率和保真度优于最先进的离散音频语言模型，有助于实现轻量级、高质量的音频生成。同时，发布了一个开源的1亿参数的文本转语音模型Pocket TTS，该模型可以在笔记本电脑CPU上以快于实时（faster than real time）的速度运行。
AI.translation: 音频语言模型（ALM）通过将音频表示为离散代币序列，已成为语音和音乐生成的主导范式。然而，与可逆的文本代币不同，音频代币是从比特率有限的有损编解码器中提取的。因此，提高音频质量需要生成更多的代币，这在保真度和计算成本之间造成了权衡。我们通过研究连续音频语言模型（CALM）来解决这个问题。这些模型实例化了一个大型Transformer主干网络，用于在每个时间步生成上下文嵌入。然后，该序列信息调节一个MLP，通过一致性建模生成音频VAE的下一个连续帧。通过避免有损压缩，CALM以比其离散对应模型更低的计算成本实现了更高的质量。在语音和音乐上的实验表明，其效率和保真度优于最先进的离散音频语言模型，有助于实现轻量级、高质量的音频生成。样本可在 hf.co/spaces/kyutai/calm-samples 获取。最后，我们发布了Pocket TTS，一个开源的1亿参数的文本转语音模型，它可以在笔记本电脑CPU上以快于实时的速度运行：github.com/kyutai-labs/pocket-tts。
AI.summary: 本文提出了连续音频语言模型（CALM），旨在解决现有离散音频语言模型（ALM）因使用有损编解码器产生的质量-成本权衡问题。CALM利用大型Transformer生成上下文嵌入，并使用MLP通过一致性建模直接生成音频VAE的连续帧，从而避免了有损压缩。实验证明CALM在语音和音乐生成上比离散模型具有更高的效率和保真度。此外，作者还开源了一个高效的文本转语音模型Pocket TTS。
AI.keywords: 连续音频语言模型, 文本转语音, Transformer, 音频生成, VAE
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将音频语言模型从传统的离散代币范式转向连续建模（CALM）。通过直接生成连续的音频VAE帧并避免有损压缩，该方法有效地解决了现有ALM在提高保真度时计算成本激增的固有矛盾。这种方法提高了效率和生成质量，对于推动轻量级、高质量的音频（特别是文本转语音）生成具有重要意义，尤其体现在开源的Pocket TTS模型能够在CPU上实现超实时运行。

title: PIE: Performance Interval Estimation for Free-Form Generation Tasks
summary: Confidence estimation infers a probability for whether each model output is correct or not. While predicting such binary correctness is sensible for tasks with exact answers, free-form generation tasks are often more nuanced, with output quality being both fine-grained and multi-faceted. We thus propose Performance Interval Estimation (PIE) to predict both: 1) point estimates for any arbitrary set of continuous-valued evaluation metrics; and 2) calibrated uncertainty intervals around these point estimates. We then compare two approaches: LLM-as-judge vs. classic regression with confidence estimation features. Evaluation over 11 datasets spans summarization, translation, code generation, function-calling, and question answering. Regression is seen to achieve both: i) lower error point estimates of metric scores; and ii) well-calibrated uncertainty intervals. To support reproduction and follow-on work, we share our data and code.

AI.title_translation: PIE：自由形式生成任务的性能区间估计
AI.tldr: 针对自由形式生成任务，本文提出了性能区间估计（PIE），用于预测连续评估指标的点估计及其不确定性区间。在11个数据集上，经典的回归方法在准确性和校准性上均优于“LLM作为评判者”的方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的置信度估计只预测二元正确性，这对于输出质量细致且多面的自由形式生成任务来说不够充分。
AI.method: 提出了性能区间估计（PIE），用于预测任意连续评估指标的点估计及其校准的不确定性区间。比较了两种方法：“LLM作为评判者”的方法，以及使用置信度估计特征的经典回归方法。
AI.result: 在涵盖摘要、翻译、代码生成、函数调用和问答的11个数据集上进行评估，发现回归方法实现了更低误差的指标分数点估计和校准良好的不确定性区间。
AI.conclusion: 经典的回归方法是实现自由形式生成任务中性能区间估计（PIE）的最佳方法，它能提供准确的点估计和可靠的不确定性区间。
AI.translation: 置信度估计推断每个模型输出是否正确的概率。虽然预测这种二元正确性对于具有精确答案的任务是合理的，但自由形式生成任务往往更加微妙，其输出质量既细致入微又多方面。因此，我们提出了性能区间估计（PIE），旨在预测：1）任意一组连续值评估指标的点估计；以及2）围绕这些点估计的校准不确定性区间。随后，我们比较了两种方法：“LLM作为评判者”与具有置信度估计特征的经典回归方法。评估涵盖了摘要、翻译、代码生成、函数调用和问答等11个数据集。结果显示，回归方法实现了两个目标：i) 更低误差的指标分数点估计；以及ii) 校准良好的不确定性区间。为了支持复现和后续工作，我们共享了数据和代码。
AI.summary: 针对自由形式生成任务的细微复杂性，本文提出了性能区间估计（PIE），它能够预测连续评估指标的点估计及其校准的不确定性区间。通过在11个多样化数据集上比较“LLM作为评判者”和经典回归方法，研究发现经典回归方法在提供更准确的指标分数点估计和更可靠的不确定性区间方面表现更优。
AI.keywords: 性能区间估计, 自由形式生成, 不确定性, 回归, LLM作为评判者
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将模型性能评估从传统的二元置信度估计（正确/错误）扩展到连续的性能区间估计（PIE），这更适用于自由形式生成任务的复杂性和多面性。研究结果表明，在预测连续指标分数及其不确定性方面，特征驱动的经典回归方法优于当前流行的“LLM作为评判者”范式，这对资源有限或需要高可靠性估计的场景具有重要的实践指导意义。

title: Variational data assimilation for the wave equation in heterogeneous media: Numerical investigation of stability
summary: In recent years, several numerical methods for solving the unique continuation problem for the wave equation in a homogeneous medium with given data on the lateral boundary of the space-time cylinder have been proposed. This problem enjoys Lipschitz stability if the geometric control condition is fulfilled, which allows devising optimally convergent numerical methods. In this article, we investigate whether these results carry over to the case in which the medium exhibits a jump discontinuity. Our numerical experiments suggest a positive answer. However, we also observe that the presence of discontinuities in the medium renders the computations far more demanding than in the homogeneous case.

AI.title_translation: 异构介质中波方程的变分数据同化：稳定性数值研究
AI.tldr: 研究人员测试了用于解决波方程唯一性问题的变分数据同化方法是否适用于具有介质不连续性的情况。结果是肯定的，但计算难度显著增加。
AI.motivation: 研究已有的针对均匀介质中波方程唯一性问题的数值方法和变分数据同化技术是否能推广到介质存在跳跃不连续性的情况。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法对于存在跳跃不连续性的介质也适用（正向回答），但计算难度比均匀介质情况大得多。
AI.conclusion: 数值实验表明，针对均匀介质的变分数据同化方法在介质存在跳跃不连续性时仍然适用，但计算成本显著增加。
AI.translation: 近年来，人们提出了几种数值方法来求解在给定时空柱侧面边界数据的情况下，均匀介质中波方程的唯一性问题。如果满足几何控制条件，该问题具有利普希茨稳定性，从而可以设计出最优收敛的数值方法。在本文中，我们研究了这些结果是否可以推广到介质表现出跳跃不连续性的情况。我们的数值实验表明是肯定的。然而，我们也观察到介质中不连续性的存在使得计算比均匀情况要求高得多。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在具有跳跃不连续性的非均匀介质中，求解波方程唯一性问题的变分数据同化方法。通过数值实验验证了已有方法在异构介质中的适用性，并观察到介质不连续性使得计算要求远高于均匀介质情况。
AI.keywords: 变分数据同化, 波方程, 异构介质, 唯一性问题, 数值稳定性
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将文献中针对均匀介质的唯一性问题和变分数据同化方法扩展到了具有跳跃不连续性的非均匀介质。重要性在于验证了在复杂介质中该方法的适用性，但指出了计算复杂性增加的局限性。

title: DeKeyNLU: Enhancing Natural Language to SQL Generation through Task Decomposition and Keyword Extraction
summary: Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) provides a new model-centric paradigm that simplifies database access for non-technical users by converting natural language queries into SQL commands. Recent advancements, particularly those integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, have made significant strides in enhancing NL2SQL performance. However, challenges such as inaccurate task decomposition and keyword extraction by LLMs remain major bottlenecks, often leading to errors in SQL generation. While existing datasets aim to mitigate these issues by fine-tuning models, they struggle with over-fragmentation of tasks and lack of domain-specific keyword annotations, limiting their effectiveness. To address these limitations, we present DeKeyNLU, a novel dataset which contains 1,500 meticulously annotated QA pairs aimed at refining task decomposition and enhancing keyword extraction precision for the RAG pipeline. Fine-tuned with DeKeyNLU, we propose DeKeySQL, a RAG-based NL2SQL pipeline that employs three distinct modules for user question understanding, entity retrieval, and generation to improve SQL generation accuracy. We benchmarked multiple model configurations within DeKeySQL RAG pipeline. Experimental results demonstrate that fine-tuning with DeKeyNLU significantly improves SQL generation accuracy on both BIRD (62.31% to 69.10%) and Spider (84.2% to 88.7%) dev datasets.

AI.title_translation: 通过任务分解和关键词提取增强自然语言到 SQL 的生成
AI.tldr: 为了解决 LLM 在 NL2SQL 中任务分解和关键词提取不准的问题，我们创建了 DeKeyNLU 数据集，并基于此提出了 DeKeySQL RAG 管道，该管道通过三个模块（理解、检索、生成）显著提高了在 BIRD 和 Spider 上的 SQL 生成准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的 NL2SQL 模型（特别是基于 RAG 和 CoT 的模型）在任务分解和关键词提取方面存在瓶颈，容易导致 SQL 生成错误。现有数据集在解决这些问题时存在任务过度碎片化和缺乏领域特定关键词标注的局限性。
AI.method: 提出 DeKeyNLU 数据集，包含 1500 个标注的 QA 对，用于改进任务分解和关键词提取精度。在此基础上，提出 DeKeySQL，一个基于 RAG 的 NL2SQL 管道，包含用户问题理解、实体检索和生成三个模块。
AI.result: 在 BIRD 开发集上，SQL 生成准确率从 62.31% 提高到 69.10%；在 Spider 开发集上，准确率从 84.2% 提高到 88.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在 DeKeyNLU 数据集上进行微调，DeKeySQL 管道显著提高了 SQL 生成的准确性，在 BIRD 和 Spider 开发集上分别达到了 69.10% 和 88.7% 的准确率。
AI.translation: 自然语言到 SQL（NL2SQL）提供了一种新的以模型为中心的范式，通过将自然语言查询转换为 SQL 命令，简化了非技术用户对数据库的访问。最近的进展，特别是那些整合了检索增强生成（RAG）和思维链（CoT）推理的进展，在提高 NL2SQL 性能方面取得了显著的进步。然而，诸如 LLM 任务分解和关键词提取不准确等挑战仍然是主要的瓶颈，通常会导致 SQL 生成错误。虽然现有的数据集旨在通过微调模型来缓解这些问题，但它们存在任务过度碎片化和缺乏领域特定关键词标注的问题，限制了其有效性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了 DeKeyNLU，一个包含 1500 个精心标注的 QA 对的新型数据集，旨在精炼任务分解并提高 RAG 管道中关键词提取的精度。在 DeKeyNLU 上微调后，我们提出了 DeKeySQL，一个基于 RAG 的 NL2SQL 管道，它采用三个独立的模块用于用户问题理解、实体检索和生成，以提高 SQL 生成的准确性。我们对 DeKeySQL RAG 管道中的多种模型配置进行了基准测试。实验结果表明，使用 DeKeyNLU 进行微调后，在 BIRD（从 62.31% 提高到 69.10%）和 Spider（从 84.2% 提高到 88.7%）开发数据集上的 SQL 生成准确率均显著提高。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 DeKeyNLU，一个包含 1500 个 QA 对的新型数据集，旨在精炼任务分解和提高 RAG 管道中关键词提取的精度。基于此，研究人员设计了 DeKeySQL，一个三模块的 RAG 管道，用于提高 SQL 生成的准确性。实验证明，使用 DeKeyNLU 微调后，模型在 BIRD 和 Spider 数据集上的性能得到了显著提升。
AI.keywords: NL2SQL, 任务分解, 关键词提取, RAG, DeKeyNLU
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个结合任务分解和关键词提取的新数据集 DeKeyNLU，并基于此设计了 DeKeySQL 管道来解决现有 RAG 方法在 NL2SQL 中面临的分解不准确和关键词提取不精确的问题。其贡献在于通过精细标注的 QA 对直接针对性地改进了这些关键步骤。局限性在于，虽然在 BIRD 和 Spider 上取得了提升，但其效果是否能推广到更广泛的、更复杂的真实世界场景仍需观察。

title: Integrated Sensing and Communication: Rate-Distortion Fundamental Limits of State Estimator
summary: The state-dependent memoryless channel (SDMC) is employed to model the integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) system, where the transmitter conveys messages to the receiver while simultaneously estimating the state parameter of interest via the received echo signals. However, the performance of sensing has often been neglected in existing works. To address this gap, we establish the rate-distortion function for sensing performance in the SDMC model, which is defined based on standard information-theoretic principles to ensure clear operational meaning. In addition, we propose a modified Blahut-Arimoto type algorithm for solving the rate-distortion function and provide convergence proofs for the algorithm. We further define the capacity-rate-distortion tradeoff region, which unifies information-theoretic results for communication and sensing within a single optimization framework. Finally, we numerically evaluate the capacity-rate-distortion region and demonstrate the benefit of coding in terms of estimation rate for certain channels.

AI.title_translation: 集成传感与通信：状态估计器的速率-失真基本极限
AI.tldr: 本文首次在ISAC系统的SDMC模型中量化了感知性能的理论极限（速率失真函数），并提出了求解该极限和联合通信-感知性能权衡区的算法，证明了编码对估计性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有工作往往忽略了集成传感与通信（ISAC）系统中感知的性能，需要建立一个能够同时考虑通信和感知性能的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用状态依赖无记忆信道（SDMC）模型，建立基于信息论原理的感知性能速率失真函数，提出一种改进的Blahut-Arimoto型算法求解该函数，并定义了容量-速率-失真权衡区。
AI.result: 建立了SDMC模型下感知性能的速率失真函数，提出了求解该函数的改进Blahut-Arimoto型算法并提供了收敛证明，定义了统一通信和感知信息论结果的容量-速率-失真权衡区，并通过数值评估证明了编码在某些信道下对估计速率的益处。
AI.translation: 状态依赖无记忆信道（SDMC）被用来模拟集成传感与通信（ISAC）系统，其中发射机在向接收机传输消息的同时，通过接收到的回波信号估计感兴趣的状态参数。然而，现有工作往往忽略了传感的性能。为解决这一差距，我们根据标准信息论原理，基于清晰的操作意义，为SDMC模型中传感性能建立了速率失真函数。此外，我们提出了一种改进的Blahut-Arimoto型算法来求解速率失真函数，并为该算法提供了收敛证明。我们进一步定义了容量-速率-失真权衡区，它在一个单一的优化框架内统一了通信和传感的信息论结果。最后，我们对容量-速率-失真区域进行了数值评估，并证明了在某些信道下，编码在估计速率方面的好处。
AI.summary: 本文针对集成传感与通信（ISAC）系统，使用状态依赖无记忆信道（SDMC）模型，首次建立了衡量感知性能的速率失真函数。研究者提出了一种改进的Blahut-Arimoto算法来求解该函数，并定义了容量-速率-失真权衡区，该区域统一了通信和感知的性能度量。数值结果验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.keywords: 集成传感与通信, 速率失真函数, 状态估计, 联合优化, 容量-速率-失真权衡区
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将感知性能纳入了信息论框架，明确定义了状态估计的速率失真函数，并提出了求解该函数的算法。其重要性在于为集成传感与通信（ISAC）系统的联合优化提供了理论基础。摘要中未明确指出局限性。

title: ConCap: Practical Network Traffic Generation for (ML- and) Flow-based Intrusion Detection Systems
summary:
Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) have been studied in research for almost four decades. Yet, despite thousands of papers claiming scientific advances, a non-negligible number of recent works suggest that the findings of prior literature may be questionable. At the root of such a disagreement is the well-known challenge of obtaining data representative of a real-world network -- and, hence, usable for security assessments.
  We tackle such a challenge in this paper. We propose ConCap, a practical tool meant to facilitate experimental research on NIDS. Through ConCap, a researcher can set up an isolated and lightweight network environment and configure it to produce network-related data, such as packets or NetFlows, that are automatically labeled -- hence ready for fine-grained experiments. ConCap is rooted on open-source software and is designed to foster experimental reproducibility across the scientific community by sharing just one configuration file. Through comprehensive experiments on 10 different network activities, further expanded via in-depth analyses of 21 variants of two specific activities and of 100 repetitions of four other ones, we empirically verify that ConCap produces network data resembling that of a real-world network. We also carry out experiments on well-known benchmark datasets as well as on a real ``smart-home'' network, showing that, from a cyber-detection viewpoint, ConCap's automatically-labeled NetFlows are functionally equivalent to those collected in other environments. Finally, we show that ConCap enables to safely reproduce sophisticated attack chains (e.g., to test/enhance existing NIDS). Altogether, ConCap is a solution to the ``data problem'' that is plaguing NIDS research.

AI.title_translation: 面向（基于流的）入侵检测系统的实用网络流量生成器ConCap
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为ConCap的实用工具，用于生成可用于网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）研究的网络流量。ConCap能够在隔离的环境中生成并自动标记数据包和NetFlows，解决了现实世界网络数据难以获取的问题，并促进了实验的可重复性。实验表明，ConCap生成的数据与真实网络数据相似，并且在网络检测方面与真实收集的数据功能等效，还可以用于安全地复现复杂的攻击链。
AI.motivation: 网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）的研究存在数据代表性不足的问题，导致许多研究的发现可能存在疑问。获取真实世界网络数据以进行安全评估是一个长期存在的挑战。
AI.method: 提出并实现了一个名为ConCap的实用工具，该工具能够在隔离、轻量级的网络环境中配置并生成自动标记的网络数据（如数据包、NetFlows）。ConCap基于开源软件，通过共享配置文件来促进实验的可重复性。
AI.result: 通过对10种不同的网络活动、21种特定活动的变体以及100次重复的4种活动的实验验证，ConCap生成的数据能够模拟真实世界网络数据。在网络检测方面，ConCap生成的自动标记的NetFlows与在其他环境中收集的NetFlows功能等效。此外，ConCap能够安全地复现复杂的攻击链，用于测试和改进NIDS。
AI.conclusion: ConCap解决了困扰NIDS研究的数据问题，为NIDS实验研究提供了一个实用的解决方案，能够生成代表性强且易于复现的网络流量数据，并有助于安全地复现攻击。
AI.translation:
网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）的研究已有近四十年的历史。然而，尽管有数千篇论文声称取得了科学进展，但相当一部分近期研究表明，以往文献的发现可能值得怀疑。这种分歧的根源在于获取代表真实世界网络的、因此可用于安全评估的数据这一众所周知的挑战。

我们在此论文中解决了这一挑战。我们提出了ConCap，一个旨在促进NIDS实验研究的实用工具。通过ConCap，研究人员可以设置一个隔离的、轻量级的网络环境，并将其配置为生成网络相关数据，如数据包或NetFlows，这些数据是自动标记的——因此可以用于细粒度的实验。ConCap基于开源软件，并通过仅共享一个配置文件来促进科学界之间的实验可重复性。通过对10种不同的网络活动进行的综合实验，以及对两种特定活动的21种变体和另外四种活动的100次重复进行的深入分析，我们经验性地验证了ConCap生成网络数据类似于真实世界网络。我们还进行了在知名基准数据集以及真实“智能家居”网络上的实验，表明从网络检测的角度来看，ConCap自动标记的NetFlows与在其他环境中收集的NetFlows在功能上是等效的。最后，我们展示了ConCap能够安全地复现复杂的攻击链（例如，测试/增强现有的NIDS）。总而言之，ConCap是解决困扰NIDS研究的“数据问题”的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了ConCap，一个用于生成和标记网络流量数据的实用工具，旨在解决网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）研究中长期存在的数据代表性和可重复性问题。ConCap能够在隔离环境中创建逼真的网络流量，其生成的数据在网络检测任务上被证明与真实数据等效，并能安全地复现攻击，从而为NIDS的实验研究提供了可靠的基础。
AI.keywords: 网络入侵检测系统, 网络流量生成, NetFlows, 实验可重复性, 数据问题
AI.comments: ConCap的提出解决了NIDS研究领域长期存在的数据获取和可重复性难题，具有重要的实践意义。其能够生成逼真的、自动标记的网络流量，并能安全复现攻击，为NIDS的评估和开发提供了强大的支持。然而，该工具在真实复杂网络环境中的部署和性能表现仍需进一步验证。

title: Bribers, Bribers on The Chain, Is Resisting All in Vain? Trustless Consensus Manipulation Through Bribing Contracts
comments: To appear at Financial Cryptography and Data Security 2026
summary: The long-term success of cryptocurrencies largely depends on the incentive compatibility provided to the validators. Bribery attacks, facilitated trustlessly via smart contracts, threaten this foundation. This work introduces, implements, and evaluates three novel and efficient bribery contracts targeting Ethereum validators. The first bribery contract enables a briber to fork the blockchain by buying votes on their proposed blocks. The second contract incentivizes validators to voluntarily exit the consensus protocol, thus increasing the adversary's relative staking power. The third contract builds a trustless bribery market that enables the briber to auction off their manipulative power over the RANDAO, Ethereum's distributed randomness beacon. Finally, we provide an initial game-theoretical analysis of one of the described bribery markets.
comment: To appear at Financial Cryptography and Data Security 2026

AI.title_translation: 链上的贿赂者，贿赂者，抵抗都是徒劳的吗？通过贿赂合约实现的信任最小化共识操纵
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了三种无需信任的智能合约，可用于贿赂以太坊验证者，以实现链分叉、使验证者退出协议或拍卖对随机性来源的控制权，表明基于智能合约的贿赂攻击是可行的。
AI.motivation: 加密货币的长期成功依赖于对验证者的激励兼容性，而通过智能合约实现的信任最小化的贿赂攻击威胁着这一基础。
AI.method: 介绍、实现并评估了三种新颖且高效的贿赂智能合约，并对其中一个贿赂市场进行了初步的博弈论分析。
AI.result: 成功引入并评估了三种针对以太坊验证者的贿赂合约：一种用于通过购买区块投票来分叉区块链；一种用于激励验证者自愿退出共识协议以增加攻击者的相对权益；以及一种用于拍卖对RANDAO的操纵权力的信任最小化贿赂市场。
AI.translation: 加密货币的长期成功在很大程度上取决于向验证者提供的激励兼容性。通过智能合约信任最小化地促成的贿赂攻击威胁着这一基础。这项工作介绍、实现并评估了三种针对以太坊验证者的新颖且高效的贿赂合约。第一个贿赂合约使贿赂者能够通过购买对其提议区块的投票来分叉区块链。第二个合约激励验证者自愿退出共识协议，从而增加攻击者的相对权益。第三个合约建立了一个信任最小化的贿赂市场，使贿赂者能够拍卖其对以太坊分布式随机性信标RANDAO的操纵权力。最后，我们对所描述的贿赂市场之一提供了初步的博弈论分析。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了通过智能合约进行的信任最小化贿赂攻击对依赖激励兼容性的加密货币基础构成的威胁。作者设计并评估了三种新颖的贿赂合约，分别用于购买区块投票以实现链分叉、激励验证者退出共识以增强攻击者权益，以及建立拍卖随机性信标（RANDAO）操纵权力的市场。最后，对其中一个市场进行了初步的博弈论分析。
AI.keywords: 贿赂攻击, 智能合约, 以太坊验证者, 链上共识操纵, 信任最小化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于设计了三种新颖且高效的、通过智能合约实现的、无需信任的贿赂合约，直接针对以太坊验证者的核心机制（投票、退出和RANDAO），揭示了基于智能合约的贿赂攻击的严重性。其重要性在于直接挑战了加密货币依赖的激励兼容性基础。局限性在于仅对其中一个市场进行了初步的博弈论分析。

title: SolContractEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Contract-Level Solidity Code Generation
summary:
The rise of blockchain has brought smart contracts into mainstream use, creating a demand for smart contract generation tools. While large language models (LLMs) excel at generating code in general-purpose languages, their effectiveness on Solidity, the primary language for smart contracts, remains underexplored. Solidity constitutes only a small portion of typical LLM training data and differs from general-purpose languages in its version-sensitive syntax and limited flexibility. These factors raise concerns about the reliability of existing LLMs for Solidity code generation. Critically, existing evaluations, focused on isolated functions and synthetic inputs, fall short of assessing models' capabilities in real-world contract development.
  To bridge this gap, we introduce SolContractEval, the first contract-level benchmark for Solidity code generation. It comprises 124 tasks drawn from real on-chain contracts across nine major domains. Each task input, consisting of complete context dependencies, a structured contract framework, and a concise task prompt, is independently annotated and cross-validated by experienced developers. To enable precise and automated evaluation of functional correctness, we also develop a dynamic evaluation framework based on historical transaction replay. Building on SolContractEval, we perform a systematic evaluation of six mainstream LLMs. We find that Claude-3.7-Sonnet achieves the highest overall performance, though evaluated models underperform relative to their capabilities on class-level generation tasks in general-purpose programming languages. Second, current models perform better on tasks that follow standard patterns but struggle with complex logic and inter-contract dependencies. Finally, they exhibit limited understanding of Solidity-specific features and contextual dependencies.

AI.title_translation: SolContractEval：一个用于评估合约级别 Solidity 代码生成的基准
AI.tldr: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成 Solidity 代码方面表现不佳，尤其是在处理真实世界的合约开发任务时。SolContractEval 基准和评估框架旨在解决这一问题，并已用于评估主流 LLMs，结果表明它们在处理复杂逻辑和特定 Solidity 功能方面存在局限性。
AI.motivation: 评估现有 LLMs 在 Solidity 代码生成方面的有效性，尤其是在真实世界的合约开发场景中，因为现有评估方法侧重于孤立函数和合成输入，未能充分衡量模型在真实合约开发中的能力。
AI.method: 引入 SolContractEval，一个包含 124 个真实链上合约任务的合约级别基准，并开发了一个基于历史交易重放的动态评估框架，用于对六种主流 LLMs 进行系统评估。
AI.result: 在 SolContractEval 基准上，Claude-3.7-Sonnet 表现最佳，但所有模型在合约级别任务上的表现均不如在通用编程语言的类级别生成任务上。模型在遵循标准模式的任务上表现更好，但在处理复杂逻辑和合约间依赖方面存在困难，并且对 Solidity 特定的功能和上下文依赖的理解有限。
AI.conclusion: 现有 LLMs 在 Solidity 合约生成方面仍有很大提升空间，尤其是在处理复杂逻辑、合约间依赖和 Solidity 特定的功能方面。SolContractEval 为未来该领域的研究提供了重要的基准和评估工具。
AI.translation:
区块链的兴起使得智能合约得到广泛应用，从而催生了对智能合约生成工具的需求。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成通用编程语言代码方面表现出色，但它们在 Solidity（智能合约的主要语言）上的有效性仍有待探索。Solidity 在典型的 LLM 训练数据中占比很小，并且与通用编程语言不同，它具有版本敏感的语法和有限的灵活性。这些因素引发了对现有 LLMs 在 Solidity 代码生成方面可靠性的担忧。至关重要的是，现有的评估侧重于孤立的函数和合成输入，未能充分评估模型在真实合约开发中的能力。
为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了 SolContractEval，这是第一个用于 Solidity 代码生成的合约级别基准。它包含 124 个来自九个主要领域的真实链上合约的任务。每个任务输入都包含完整的上下文依赖、结构化的合约框架和简洁的任务提示，并由经验丰富的开发人员独立标注和交叉验证。为了实现对功能正确性的精确和自动化评估，我们还开发了一个基于历史交易重放的动态评估框架。基于 SolContractEval，我们对六种主流 LLMs 进行了系统评估。我们发现 Claude-3.7-Sonnet 取得了最高的整体性能，尽管与它们在通用编程语言的类级别生成任务上的能力相比，所评估的模型表现有所下降。其次，当前模型在遵循标准模式的任务上表现更好，但在处理复杂逻辑和合约间依赖方面存在困难。最后，它们对 Solidity 特定的功能和上下文依赖的理解有限。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了 SolContractEval，一个用于评估 Solidity 代码生成的合约级别基准。该基准包含 124 个真实世界的合约任务，并辅以动态评估框架。对六种主流 LLMs 的评估显示，尽管 Claude-3.7-Sonnet 表现最佳，但所有模型在处理复杂逻辑、合约间依赖和 Solidity 特性方面仍存在显著局限性。
AI.keywords: Solidity,智能合约,代码生成,LLMs,基准测试,SolContractEval
AI.comments: 该研究填补了 Solidity 代码生成评估领域的空白，提出了一个具有实际意义的基准和评估框架。然而，模型在处理复杂逻辑和 Solidity 特有功能方面的局限性表明，未来需要进一步的研究来提高 LLMs 在此领域的性能。

title: MRAG-Suite: A Diagnostic Evaluation Platform for Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Visual RAG) significantly advances question answering by integrating visual and textual evidence. Yet, current evaluations fail to systematically account for query difficulty and ambiguity. We propose MRAG-Suite, a diagnostic evaluation platform integrating diverse multimodal benchmarks (WebQA, Chart-RAG, Visual-RAG, MRAG-Bench). We introduce difficulty-based and ambiguity-aware filtering strategies, alongside MM-RAGChecker, a claim-level diagnostic tool. Our results demonstrate substantial accuracy reductions under difficult and ambiguous queries, highlighting prevalent hallucinations. MM-RAGChecker effectively diagnoses these issues, guiding future improvements in Visual RAG systems.

AI.title_translation: MRAG-Suite：视觉检索增强生成的诊断评估平台
AI.tldr: MRAG-Suite 是一个用于评估视觉检索增强生成（Visual RAG）的平台，通过引入难度和歧义过滤策略以及一个名为 MM-RAGChecker 的诊断工具，揭示了现有系统中存在的幻觉问题，并为未来的改进提供了方向。
AI.motivation: 现有对视觉检索增强生成（Visual RAG）的评估未能系统地考虑查询的难度和歧义性。
AI.method: 提出 MRAG-Suite 评估平台，包含多个基准测试（WebQA、Chart-RAG、Visual-RAG、MRAG-Bench），并引入基于难度的过滤策略、歧义感知过滤策略以及一个名为 MM-RAGChecker 的声明级别诊断工具。
AI.result: 在困难和模糊的查询下，准确率显著下降，揭示了普遍存在的幻觉问题。MM-RAGChecker 能够有效诊断这些问题。
AI.conclusion: MRAG-Suite 能够诊断视觉 RAG 系统在处理困难和模糊查询时的不足，有助于未来的改进。
AI.translation: 多模态检索增强生成（Visual RAG）通过整合视觉和文本证据，极大地推动了问答的发展。然而，目前的评估未能系统地考虑查询的难度和歧义性。我们提出了 MRAG-Suite，一个整合了多种多模态基准（WebQA、Chart-RAG、Visual-RAG、MRAG-Bench）的诊断评估平台。我们引入了基于难度的过滤策略和歧义感知的过滤策略，以及一个声明级别的诊断工具 MM-RAGChecker。我们的结果表明，在困难和模糊的查询下，准确率显著下降，凸显了普遍存在的幻觉问题。MM-RAGChecker 能够有效诊断这些问题，指导未来 Visual RAG 系统的改进。
AI.summary: MRAG-Suite 是一个创新的视觉检索增强生成（Visual RAG）诊断评估平台。它通过整合多种多模态基准，并引入独特的难度和歧义过滤策略，以及一个名为 MM-RAGChecker 的声明级诊断工具，系统地评估了 Visual RAG 系统的性能。研究结果表明，在面对困难和模糊查询时，现有 Visual RAG 系统存在显著的准确率下降和幻觉问题。MRAG-Suite 的诊断能力为未来改进 Visual RAG 系统提供了宝贵的指导。
AI.keywords: 视觉检索增强生成, 诊断评估, 查询难度, 查询歧义性, 幻觉
AI.comments: 该研究通过 MRAG-Suite 平台和 MM-RAGChecker 工具，解决了视觉检索增强生成（Visual RAG）评估中的关键挑战，即查询难度和歧义性的影响。这项工作的重要性在于，它不仅揭示了现有系统中普遍存在的幻觉问题，还提供了一个可操作的诊断框架，以促进更鲁棒、更可靠的 Visual RAG 系统的发展。未来研究可以进一步探索 MM-RAGChecker 的自动化能力，以及如何利用其诊断结果来指导模型训练。

title: HiKE: Hierarchical Evaluation Framework for Korean-English Code-Switching Speech Recognition
summary: Despite advances in multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), code-switching (CS), the mixing of languages within an utterance common in daily speech, remains a severely underexplored challenge. In this paper, we introduce HiKE: the Hierarchical Korean-English code-switching benchmark, the first globally accessible non-synthetic evaluation framework for Korean-English CS, aiming to provide a means for the precise evaluation of multilingual ASR models and to foster research in the field. The proposed framework not only consists of high-quality, natural CS data across various topics, but also provides meticulous loanword labels and a hierarchical CS-level labeling scheme (word, phrase, and sentence) that together enable a systematic evaluation of a model's ability to handle each distinct level of code-switching. Through evaluations of diverse multilingual ASR models and fine-tuning experiments, this paper demonstrates that although most multilingual ASR models initially exhibit inadequate CS-ASR performance, this capability can be enabled through fine-tuning with synthetic CS data. HiKE is available at https://github.com/ThetaOne-AI/HiKE.

AI.title_translation: HiKE：韩英代码转换语音识别的分层评估框架
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了HiKE，一个用于评估韩英代码转换语音识别的新基准测试工具。他们发现，现有的多语言语音识别模型在处理代码转换时表现不佳，但可以通过使用合成代码转换数据进行微调来提高性能。

AI.conclusion: 评估结果表明，大多数多语言ASR模型在初始阶段对代码转换的识别性能不足，但通过使用合成的CS数据进行微调，可以显著提升其CS-ASR能力。

AI.keywords: 代码转换, 语音识别, 评估框架, 韩英, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个专门针对韩英代码转换（CS）的、首次可公开获取的、非合成的基准测试框架（HiKE）。其重要性在于为精确评估多语言ASR模型在处理CS场景下的能力提供了一个系统性的工具。局限性在于，评估结果主要集中在证明现有模型需要通过合成数据微调才能获得可接受的CS-ASR性能，但并未深入探讨更先进的架构或训练策略。

title: LTL$_f$ Learning Meets Boolean Set Cover
comments: Full version of TACAS 2026 conference paper. 24 pages, 4 figures
summary: Learning formulas in Linear Temporal Logic (LTLf) from finite traces is a fundamental research problem which has found applications in artificial intelligence, software engineering, programming languages, formal methods, control of cyber-physical systems, and robotics. We implement a new CPU tool called Bolt improving over the state of the art by learning formulas more than 100x faster over 70% of the benchmarks, with smaller or equal formulas in 98% of the cases. Our key insight is to leverage a problem called Boolean Set Cover as a subroutine to combine existing formulas using Boolean connectives. Thanks to the Boolean Set Cover component, our approach offers a novel trade-off between efficiency and formula size.

title: A Computational Social Simulation of Ageing and Care Accessibility in Italian Inner Areas
comments: Comments: 18 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Ageing societies face increasing strain on formal and informal care systems, particularly in low-density mountainous municipalities where sparse services and steep terrain constrain access. This study presents a spatially explicit agent-based model that integrates a road-network GIS, synthetic populations derived through Iterative Proportional Fitting, and behavioural heterogeneity to examine how alternative service configurations shape accessibility and caregiver burden. The model, applied to Premeno (Piedmont, Italy), compares a baseline distribution of ambulatory services with a relocation scenario at Villa Bernocchi. System-level indicators (Caregiver Effort, Overwhelmed Caregivers, Hours Not Cared, Walkability) and micro-spatial metrics (Walkability, Detour Ratio, Proximity) are analysed across 40 batches and 50 stochastic replications per scenario. Results reveal aggregate neutrality but pronounced local redistribution of accessibility. Sensitivity analysis shows that spatial impedance dominates accessibility, whereas behavioural capacity modulates care effort. The findings illustrate distinctive properties of complex adaptive social systems - emergence, heterogeneity, and feedback - demonstrating how computational social simulation can highlight policy trade-offs between spatial efficiency, social equity, and care sustainability in ageing territories.

AI.title_translation: 意大利内陆地区老龄化与护理可及性的计算社会模拟
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用基于主体的空间模型模拟了意大利山区小镇（Premeno）老龄化背景下的护理可及性问题，发现服务位置的改变主要影响局部可及性，且空间因素比行为因素对可及性影响更大，为平衡效率与公平的护理政策提供了见解。
AI.motivation: 老龄化社会对正规和非正规护理系统造成日益增加的压力，特别是在服务稀疏和陡峭地形限制了可及性的低密度山区城市。
AI.method: 应用一个整合了路网GIS、通过迭代比例拟合得出的合成人口以及行为异质性的空间显式基于主体的模型（ABM），以检验替代服务配置如何影响可及性和护理者负担。分析了系统级指标和微观空间指标。
AI.result: 结果显示，总体可及性保持中性，但在局部存在显著的重新分配。敏感性分析表明，空间阻抗对可及性起主导作用，而行为能力调节着护理的努力程度。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，计算社会模拟可以突出复杂适应性社会系统（如涌现性、异质性和反馈）的独特性质，并能揭示在老龄化地区平衡空间效率、社会公平和护理可持续性方面的政策权衡。
AI.translation: 老龄化社会正面临着对正规和非正规护理系统日益增加的压力，特别是在服务稀疏和陡峭地形限制了可及性的低密度山区城市。本研究提出了一个空间显式的基于主体的模型，该模型整合了路网GIS、通过迭代比例拟合得出的合成人口以及行为异质性，以检验替代服务配置如何影响可及性和护理者负担。该模型应用于皮埃蒙特大区的Premeno市，比较了门诊服务基线分布与在Villa Bernocchi的重新部署情景。对40个批次和每个情景的50次随机重复进行了系统级指标（护理者努力、超负荷护理者、未被护理时间、步行性）和微观空间指标（步行性、绕路比、邻近性）的分析。结果显示总体上保持中性，但在局部存在显著的重新分配。敏感性分析表明，空间阻抗主导了可及性，而行为能力调节着护理的努力程度。研究结果阐明了复杂适应性社会系统的独特属性——涌现性、异质性和反馈——证明了计算社会模拟如何突出在老龄化地区平衡空间效率、社会公平和护理可持续性方面的政策权衡。
AI.summary: 本研究利用一个空间显式基于主体的模型，结合GIS和合成人口数据，模拟了意大利Premeno市在不同服务配置下老龄人口的护理可及性和护理者负担。研究发现，服务重新配置会导致可及性的局部重新分配，并揭示了空间因素和行为因素对护理压力的不同影响，强调了计算模拟在评估老龄化地区护理政策权衡中的价值。

title: SLogic: Subgraph-Informed Logical Rule Learning for Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Logical rule-based methods offer an interpretable approach to knowledge graph completion (KGC) by capturing compositional relationships in the form of human-readable inference rules. While existing logical rule-based methods learn rule confidence scores, they typically assign a global weight to each rule schema, applied uniformly across the graph. This is a significant limitation, as a rule's importance often varies depending on the specific query instance. To address this, we introduce SLogic (Subgraph-Informed Logical Rule learning), a novel framework that assigns query-dependent scores to logical rules. The core of SLogic is a context-aware scoring function. This function determines the importance of a rule by analyzing the subgraph locally defined by the query's head entity, thereby enabling a differentiated weighting of rules specific to their local query contexts. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that SLogic outperforms existing rule-based methods and achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art baselines. It also generates query-dependent, human-readable logical rules that serve as explicit explanations for its inferences.

AI.title_translation: SLogic：用于知识图谱补全的子图感知逻辑规则学习
AI.tldr: SLogic 提出了一种新的知识图谱补全框架，通过为逻辑规则分配与查询相关的分数来解决现有方法的局限性，从而实现更精细的规则加权。
AI.motivation: 现有逻辑规则学习方法为每个规则模式分配全局权重，无法捕捉规则对特定查询实例的重要性差异。
AI.method: SLogic 引入了一个上下文感知的评分函数，该函数通过分析由查询头实体定义的局部子图来确定规则的重要性，从而实现规则的区分加权。
AI.result: SLogic 在基准数据集上的实验表明，其性能优于现有的基于规则的方法，并能与最先进的方法相媲美，同时生成可解释的、与查询相关的逻辑规则。
AI.conclusion: SLogic 通过引入查询依赖的规则评分机制，克服了现有逻辑规则方法的局限性，并在知识图谱补全任务中取得了优越的性能和可解释性。
AI.translation: 基于逻辑规则的方法通过以人类可读的推理规则形式捕获组合关系，为知识图谱补全（KGC）提供了一种可解释的方法。虽然现有的基于逻辑规则的方法可以学习规则置信度分数，但它们通常为每个规则模式分配一个全局权重，该权重在整个图上统一应用。这是一个重大的局限性，因为规则的重要性通常因特定查询实例而异。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 SLogic（子图感知逻辑规则学习），一个为逻辑规则分配与查询相关的分数的新颖框架。SLogic 的核心是一个上下文感知的评分函数。该函数通过分析由查询头实体局部定义的子图来确定规则的重要性，从而实现对特定于其局部查询上下文的规则进行区分加权。在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，SLogic 的性能优于现有的基于规则的方法，并且在与最先进的基线相比时具有竞争力。它还生成与查询相关的、人类可读的逻辑规则，作为其推理的明确解释。
AI.summary: SLogic 是一种新颖的知识图谱补全框架，它通过为逻辑规则分配与查询相关的分数来解决现有方法的局限性。通过分析查询头实体相关的局部子图，SLogic 能够根据具体查询上下文对规则进行区分加权，从而提高了 KGC 的性能和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱补全, 逻辑规则学习, 子图感知, 查询相关评分, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的子图感知方法来学习逻辑规则，解决了现有方法在规则加权方面的局限性。通过引入查询依赖评分，SLogic 提高了 KGC 的性能和可解释性，尤其是在处理需要精细区分规则重要性的复杂查询时。然而，该方法在处理大规模知识图谱时的计算效率和可扩展性仍有待进一步研究。

title: Human Mobility Datasets Enriched With Contextual and Social Dimensions
summary: In this resource paper, we present two publicly available datasets of semantically enriched human trajectories, together with the pipeline to build them. The trajectories are publicly available GPS traces retrieved from OpenStreetMap. Each dataset includes contextual layers such as stops, moves, points of interest (POIs), inferred transportation modes, and weather data. A novel semantic feature is the inclusion of synthetic, realistic social media posts generated by Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling multimodal and semantic mobility analysis. The datasets are available in both tabular and Resource Description Framework (RDF) formats, supporting semantic reasoning and FAIR data practices. They cover two structurally distinct, large cities: Paris and New York. Our open source reproducible pipeline allows for dataset customization, while the datasets support research tasks such as behavior modeling, mobility prediction, knowledge graph construction, and LLM-based applications. To our knowledge, our resource is the first to combine real-world movement, structured semantic enrichment, LLM-generated text, and semantic web compatibility in a reusable framework.

AI.title_translation: 包含上下文和社会维度的丰富人类出行数据集
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了两个公开可用的人类轨迹数据集，并提供了构建它们的流程。这些数据集包含GPS轨迹、停靠点、移动、兴趣点（POI）、交通模式、天气数据以及由LLM生成的社交媒体帖子，支持多模态和语义出行分析。数据集采用表格和RDF格式，适用于巴黎和纽约，并支持行为建模、出行预测、知识图谱构建和LLM应用等研究任务。
AI.motivation: 为了实现多模态和语义出行分析，需要将真实世界的人类轨迹数据与上下文信息（如停靠点、兴趣点、交通模式、天气）和社会维度（如社交媒体帖子）相结合，并以支持语义推理和FAIR数据实践的格式提供。
AI.method: 从OpenStreetMap检索公开可用的GPS轨迹，并结合停靠点、移动、兴趣点（POI）、推断的交通模式和天气数据作为上下文层。利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成合成的、真实的社交媒体帖子作为社会维度。将这些数据整理成表格和RDF格式，并提供一个开源的可重现流程来构建数据集。
AI.result: 发布了两个包含语义丰富的人类轨迹的大型城市（巴黎和纽约）的公开可用数据集。数据集结合了真实GPS轨迹、上下文信息（停靠点、POI、交通模式、天气）和LLM生成的社交媒体帖子。提供了支持这些数据集构建的可重现流程。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个新颖的、包含真实轨迹、上下文信息、LLM生成社交媒体帖子以及支持语义推理和FAIR数据实践的数据集框架，为多模态和语义出行分析以及相关研究任务（如行为建模、出行预测、知识图谱构建和LLM应用）提供了宝贵资源。
AI.translation: 在本资源论文中，我们提出了两个包含语义丰富的人类轨迹的公开可用数据集，以及构建它们的过程。这些轨迹是公开可用的GPS轨迹，取自OpenStreetMap。每个数据集都包含上下文层，如停靠点、移动、兴趣点（POI）、推断的交通模式和天气数据。一个新颖的语义特征是包含了由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的合成的、真实的社交媒体帖子，从而能够进行多模态和语义出行分析。这些数据集有表格和资源描述框架（RDF）两种格式，支持语义推理和FAIR数据实践。它们覆盖了两个结构不同的、大型的城市：巴黎和纽约。我们的开源可重现流程允许数据集的定制，同时这些数据集支持行为建模、出行预测、知识图谱构建和LLM应用等研究任务。据我们所知，我们的资源是第一个在可重用框架中结合了真实世界的移动、结构化的语义丰富、LLM生成的文本以及语义网络兼容性的资源。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍并发布了两个包含丰富上下文和社会维度信息的人类出行数据集。这些数据集基于公开的GPS轨迹，并整合了停靠点、兴趣点、交通模式、天气等上下文信息，以及利用大型语言模型生成的社交媒体帖子。数据集支持表格和RDF格式，并提供了一个可重现的流程来构建和定制。研究旨在促进多模态、语义出行分析、行为建模、出行预测、知识图谱构建和LLM应用等领域的研究。
AI.keywords: 人类出行, 数据集, 上下文信息, LLM, 社交媒体帖子
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将真实的人类轨迹数据与LLM生成的社交媒体帖子相结合，为出行分析增加了社会维度。RDF格式的支持和FAIR数据实践的遵循，提高了数据的可访问性和可重用性。然而，LLM生成帖子的真实性和潜在偏差可能是需要考虑的方面。该资源对于需要结合多维度信息进行出行研究的学者来说非常有价值。

title: AutoContext: Instance-Level Context Learning for LLM Agents
summary: Current LLM agents typically lack instance-level context, which comprises concrete facts such as environment structure, system configurations, and local mechanics. Consequently, existing methods are forced to intertwine exploration with task execution. This coupling leads to redundant interactions and fragile decision-making, as agents must repeatedly rediscover the same information for every new task. To address this, we introduce AutoContext, a method that decouples exploration from task solving. AutoContext performs a systematic, one-off exploration to construct a reusable knowledge graph for each environment instance. This structured context allows off-the-shelf agents to access necessary facts directly, eliminating redundant exploration. Experiments across TextWorld, ALFWorld, Crafter, and InterCode-Bash demonstrate substantial gains: for example, the success rate of a ReAct agent on TextWorld improves from 37% to 95%, highlighting the critical role of structured instance context in efficient agentic systems.

AI.title_translation: 自动上下文：LLM代理的实例级上下文学习
AI.tldr: LLM代理缺乏实例级上下文，导致冗余交互和脆弱的决策。AutoContext通过一次性探索构建可重用的知识图谱来解决这个问题，将探索与任务解决分离，从而提高效率和成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前的LLM代理缺乏环境结构、系统配置和局部机制等实例级上下文，导致探索与任务执行交织，造成冗余交互和脆弱的决策。
AI.method: AutoContext通过一次性系统性探索构建每个环境实例的可重用知识图谱，将探索与任务解决解耦。
AI.result: 在TextWorld、ALFWorld、Crafter和InterCode-Bash上的实验表明，AutoContext显著提高了性能。例如，在TextWorld上，ReAct代理的成功率从37%提高到95%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的实例上下文在高效的代理系统中起着至关重要的作用。
AI.translation: 当前的LLM代理通常缺乏实例级上下文，包括环境结构、系统配置和局部机制等具体事实。因此，现有方法被迫将探索与任务执行交织在一起。这种耦合导致了冗余的交互和脆弱的决策，因为代理必须为每个新任务反复重新发现相同的信息。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了AutoContext，一种将探索与任务解决解耦的方法。AutoContext执行一次性的系统性探索，为每个环境实例构建一个可重用的知识图谱。这种结构化的上下文允许现成的代理直接访问所需的事实，从而消除冗余的探索。在TextWorld、ALFWorld、Crafter和InterCode-Bash上的实验证明了显著的收益：例如，ReAct代理在TextWorld上的成功率从37%提高到95%，凸显了结构化实例上下文在高效代理系统中的关键作用。
AI.summary: AutoContext是一种新方法，通过为每个环境实例构建一个可重用的知识图谱，将LLM代理的探索与任务解决解耦，从而解决了当前LLM代理缺乏实例级上下文的问题。这种结构化的上下文消除了冗余的探索，显著提高了代理在各种环境中的效率和成功率。
AI.keywords: LLM代理,实例级上下文,AutoContext,知识图谱,探索解耦
AI.comments: 该研究解决了LLM代理在处理实例级上下文方面的关键挑战，通过AutoContext方法提出了一种有效的解决方案。将探索与任务解决解耦并构建可重用的知识图谱，不仅提高了效率，还增强了决策的鲁棒性。实验结果令人印象深刻，尤其是在TextWorld上的成功率大幅提升，证明了该方法的有效性。未来工作可以探索AutoContext在更复杂和动态环境中的应用，以及其对代理可解释性的影响。

title: Pushing on Multilingual Reasoning Models with Language-Mixed Chain-of-Thought
summary: Recent frontier models employ long chain-of-thought reasoning to explore solution spaces in context and achieve stonger performance. While many works study distillation to build smaller yet capable models, most focus on English and little is known about language-specific reasoning. To bridge this gap, we first introduct **Language-Mixed CoT**, a reasoning schema that switches between English and a target language, using English as an anchor to excel in reasoning while minimizing translation artificats. As a Korean case study, we curate **Yi-Sang**: 5.79M native-Korean prompts from web Q&A, exams, STEM, and code; 3.7M long reasoning traces generated from Qwen3-32B; and a targeted 260k high-yield subset. We train ninve models (4B-35B) across six families (Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, Gemma-3, etc). Our best model, **KO-REAson-35B**, achieves state-of-the-art performance, with the highest overall average score (64.0 \pm 25), ranking first on 5/9 benchmarks and second on the remainder. Samller and mid-sized models also benefit substantially, with an average improvement of +18.6 points across teh evaluated nine benchmarks. Ablations show **Language-Mixed CoT** is more effective than monolingual CoT, also resulting in cross-lingual and mult-modal performance gains. We release our data-curation pipeline, evaluation system, datasets, and models to advance research on language-specific reasoning. Data and model collection: https://huggingface.co/KOREAson.

AI.title_translation: 多语言链式思考推理模型的语言混合
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了语言混合思维链（Language-Mixed CoT）方法，通过在英语和目标语言之间切换，利用英语作为推理的锚点，同时最小化翻译的痕迹。研究人员构建了一个包含579万个韩语提示、370万个推理轨迹以及26万个高质量子集的韩语数据集Yi-Sang。在Yi-Sang数据集上训练的模型，特别是KO-REAson-35B，在多项基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，并且语言混合思维链比单一语言的思维链更有效，同时还能带来跨语言和多模态的性能提升。研究团队公开了数据处理流程、评估系统、数据集和模型，以促进语言特定推理的研究。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型在推理方面表现出色，但大多集中于英语，对特定语言的推理能力了解甚少。该研究旨在弥合这一差距，探索在非英语环境中提升模型推理能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“语言混合思维链”（Language-Mixed CoT）的推理方法，该方法允许模型在英语和目标语言之间切换，利用英语进行推理，并尽量减少翻译引入的误差。研究人员构建了一个名为Yi-Sang的韩语数据集，并使用该数据集在六个系列（包括Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、Gemma-3等）的九个模型（4B-35B）上进行了训练。
AI.result: 在Yi-Sang数据集上训练的KO-REAson-35B模型达到了最先进的性能，在9个基准测试中的5个上排名第一，其余排名第二，平均得分最高（64.0 ± 25）。较小和中等规模的模型性能也得到了显著提升，平均提高了18.6分。消融实验表明，语言混合思维链比单一语言思维链更有效，并带来了跨语言和多模态的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 语言混合思维链是一种有效的推理方法，可以提升模型在特定语言下的推理能力，并带来跨语言和多模态的性能增益。研究构建的Yi-Sang数据集和训练的模型为进一步研究语言特定推理奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 近期前沿模型采用长链式思考推理来探索上下文中的解空间并取得更强的性能。虽然许多工作研究了蒸馏以构建更小但功能强大的模型，但大多数都集中在英语上，而对特定语言的推理知之甚少。为了弥合这一差距，我们首先介绍了**语言混合CoT**，这是一种在英语和目标语言之间切换的推理模式，利用英语作为锚点以在推理方面表现出色，同时最大限度地减少翻译的痕迹。作为韩语案例研究，我们整理了**Yi-Sang**：包含来自网络问答、考试、STEM和代码的579万个原生韩语提示；由Qwen3-32B生成的370万个长推理轨迹；以及一个有针对性的26万个高产子集。我们训练了九个模型（4B-35B），涵盖六个系列（Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、Gemma-3等）。我们最好的模型**KO-REAson-35B**取得了最先进的性能，总体平均得分最高（64.0 ± 25），在9个基准测试中的5个上排名第一，其余排名第二。较小和中等规模的模型也得到了显著的益处，在评估的九个基准测试中的平均改进为+18.6分。消融实验表明，**语言混合CoT**比单一语言CoT更有效，同时也带来了跨语言和多模态的性能提升。我们发布了我们的数据整理流程、评估系统、数据集和模型，以促进语言特定推理的研究。数据和模型收集：https://huggingface.co/KOREAson。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的“语言混合思维链”（Language-Mixed CoT）方法，旨在提升大型语言模型在非英语语言中的推理能力。该方法通过在英语和目标语言之间灵活切换，利用英语的优势进行推理，同时减少翻译带来的误差。研究团队构建了一个大规模的韩语数据集Yi-Sang，并在此基础上训练了一系列模型。实验结果表明，使用语言混合思维链训练的模型，尤其是KO-REAson-35B，在韩语推理任务上取得了最先进的性能，并且优于单一语言的思维链方法。此外，该方法还能提升模型的跨语言和多模态能力。研究人员已公开相关数据、模型和工具，以推动语言特定推理领域的研究。
AI.keywords: 语言混合思维链, 多语言推理, 韩语数据集, 大型语言模型, 跨语言能力
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了大型语言模型在非英语语言推理能力上的一个重要空白。提出“语言混合思维链”的方法很有创新性，它巧妙地结合了英语的优势和目标语言的特性，以克服纯粹的翻译或单一语言训练的局限性。Yi-Sang数据集的构建及其规模令人印象深刻，为后续研究提供了宝贵资源。KO-REAson-35B模型的优异表现证明了该方法的有效性。然而，未来可以进一步探索该方法在更多样化语言和更复杂推理任务上的泛化能力，以及其对模型计算资源的需求。

title: Foundations of LLM Knowledge Materialization: Termination, Reproducibility, Robustness
comments: Accepted and published in Findings of EACL 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) encode substantial factual knowledge, yet measuring and systematizing this knowledge remains challenging. Converting it into structured format, for example through recursive extraction approaches such as the GPTKB methodology (Hu et al., 2025b), is still underexplored. Key open questions include whether such extraction can terminate, whether its outputs are reproducible, and how robust they are to variations. We systematically study LLM knowledge materialization using miniGPTKBs (domain-specific, tractable subcrawls), analyzing termination, reproducibility, and robustness across three categories of metrics: yield, lexical similarity, and semantic similarity. We experiment with four variations (seed, language, randomness, model) and three illustrative domains (from history, entertainment, and finance). Our findings show (i) high termination rates, though model-dependent; (ii) mixed reproducibility; and (iii) robustness that varies by perturbation type: high for seeds and temperature, lower for languages and models. These results suggest that LLM knowledge materialization can reliably surface core knowledge, while also revealing important limitations.
comment: Accepted and published in Findings of EACL 2026

title: Power Assumptions Matter: Evaluating End-user Laptop Energy Models for Sustainability Reporting of Browser-Based Web Services
summary:
Sustainability reporting for web-based services often relies on simplified end-user energy models that assume constant laptop power during browser interactions. Energy models such as Digst and DIMPACT apply fixed power values (15-22W), yet the validity of this approach for realistic browsing remains underexplored.
  We empirically evaluate constant-power assumptions in a controlled user study where ten participants repeatedly complete eight representative user flows across shopping, booking, navigation, and news services on four laptop platforms, while device energy is measured. Typical power is 9--13~W, substantially below current reporting standards, implying systematic overestimation. Moreover, the error scales proportionally with task duration, indicating systematic bias rather than random noise.
  Comparing progressively refined constant-power models, we find that category-specific parameters improve accuracy more than hardware-only parameters and approach flow-specific performance. The best fit is obtained by combining category (or flow) with hardware, while category-level models retain most of the benefit with fewer parameters, making them a practical upgrade for sustainability reporting.

title: Accelerating Bidiagonalization of Banded Matrices through Memory-Aware Bulge-Chasing on GPUs
summary: The reduction of a banded matrix to bidiagonal form is a critical step in the calculation of Singular Values, a cornerstone of scientific computing and AI. Although inherently parallel, this step has traditionally been considered unsuitable for GPUs due to its memory-bound nature. However, recent advances in GPU architectures, such as increased L1 memory per Streaming Multiprocessor or Compute Unit and larger L2 caches, have shifted this paradigm. In this work, we present the first GPU-accelerated algorithm for reducing a banded matrix to bidiagonal form, integrated into open-source software package NextLA.jl. Our algorithm builds on prior multicore CPU cache-efficient bulge chasing methods, adapted to modern GPU architecture to optimize throughput. Leveraging Julia's high-level array abstractions and KernelAbstractions, we implement a single function that is both hardware-agnostic and data-precision-aware, running efficiently across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple Metal GPUs. We develop a hardware-aware performance model to guide tuning and identify key hyperparameters that govern optimal GPU performance for memory-bound workloads. We show that such workloads, when carefully optimized, can achieve substantial speed-ups on modern GPUs: our implementation outperforms multithreaded CPU libraries PLASMA and SLATE starting from matrix sizes as small as 1024 x 1024, and achieves over 100x speed-up on 32k x 32k matrices. Moreover, the algorithm's performance scales linearly with the matrix bandwidth, enabling efficient reduction of matrices with larger bandwidths - previously considered impractical.

title: UNCAP: Uncertainty-Guided Neurosymbolic Planning Using Natural Language Communication for Cooperative Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Safe large-scale coordination of multiple cooperative connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) hinges on communication that is both efficient and interpretable. Existing approaches either rely on transmitting high-bandwidth raw sensor data streams or neglect perception and planning uncertainties inherent in shared data, resulting in systems that are neither scalable nor safe. To address these limitations, we propose Uncertainty-Guided Natural Language Cooperative Autonomous Planning (UNCAP), a vision-language model-based planning approach that enables CAVs to communicate via lightweight natural language messages while explicitly accounting for perception uncertainty in decision-making. UNCAP features a two-stage communication protocol: (i) an ego CAV first identifies the subset of vehicles most relevant for information exchange, and (ii) the selected CAVs then transmit messages that quantitatively express their perception uncertainty. By selectively fusing messages that maximize mutual information, this strategy allows the ego vehicle to integrate only the most relevant signals into its decision-making, improving both the scalability and reliability of cooperative planning. Experiments across diverse driving scenarios show a 63% reduction in communication bandwidth with a 31% increase in driving safety score, a 61% reduction in decision uncertainty, and a four-fold increase in collision distance margin during near-miss events. Project website: https://uncap-project.github.io/

title: Are My Optimized Prompts Compromised? Exploring Vulnerabilities of LLM-based Optimizers
comments: Proceedings of the 19th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EACL 2026)
summary: Large language model (LLM) systems increasingly power everyday AI applications such as chatbots, computer-use assistants, and autonomous robots, where performance often depends on manually well-crafted prompts. LLM-based prompt optimizers reduce that effort by iteratively refining prompts from scored feedback, yet the security of this optimization stage remains underexamined. We present the first systematic analysis of poisoning risks in LLM-based prompt optimization. Using HarmBench, we find systems are substantially more vulnerable to manipulated feedback than to query poisoning alone: feedback-based attacks raise attack success rate (ASR) by up to ΔASR = 0.48. We introduce a simple fake reward attack that requires no access to the reward model and significantly increases vulnerability. We also propose a lightweight highlighting defense that reduces the fake reward ΔASR from 0.23 to 0.07 without degrading utility. These results establish prompt optimization pipelines as a first-class attack surface and motivate stronger safeguards for feedback channels and optimization frameworks.
comment: Proceedings of the 19th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EACL 2026)

title: Instructions are all you need: Self-supervised Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following
summary: Language models often struggle to follow multi-constraint instructions that are crucial for real-world applications. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches suffer from dependency on external supervision and sparse reward signals from multi-constraint tasks. We propose a label-free self-supervised RL framework that eliminates dependency on external supervision by deriving reward signals directly from instructions and generating pseudo-labels for reward model training. Our approach introduces constraint decomposition strategies and efficient constraint-wise binary classification to address sparse reward challenges while maintaining computational efficiency. Experiments show that our approach generalizes well, achieving strong improvements across 3 in-domain and 5 out-of-domain datasets, including challenging agentic and multi-turn instruction following. The data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Rainier-rq/verl-if

title: WaveNet's Precision in EEG Classification
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures and 3 tables. Includes main text and bibliography
summary: This study introduces a WaveNet-based deep learning model designed to automate the classification of intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) signals into physiological activity, pathological (epileptic) activity, power-line noise, and other non-cerebral artifacts. Traditional methods for iEEG signal classification, which rely on expert visual review, are becoming increasingly impractical due to the growing complexity and volume of iEEG recordings. Leveraging a publicly available annotated dataset from Mayo Clinic and St. Anne's University Hospital, the WaveNet model was trained, validated, and tested on 209,231 samples using a 70/20/10 split. The model achieved a classification accuracy exceeding previous non-specialized CNN- and LSTM-based approaches and was benchmarked against a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) baseline. Notably, the model achieves high discrimination of noise and artifact classes, with precisions of 0.98 and approximately 1, respectively. Classification between physiological and pathological signals exhibits a modest but clinically interpretable overlap, with F1-scores of 0.96 and 0.90 and 175 and 272 cross-class false positives, respectively, reflecting inherent clinical overlap. WaveNet's architecture, originally developed for raw audio synthesis, is well-suited for iEEG data due to its use of dilated causal convolutions and residual connections, enabling the capture of both fine-grained and long-range temporal dependencies. The study also details the preprocessing pipeline, including dynamic dataset partitioning, the use of focal loss to address class imbalance, and normalization steps that support high model performance. While the results demonstrate strong in-distribution performance, generalizability across datasets and clinical settings has yet to be established.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures and 3 tables. Includes main text and bibliography

title: Asymptotically Stable Quaternion-valued Hopfield-structured Neural Network with Periodic Projection-based Supervised Learning Rules
summary: Motivated by the geometric advantages of quaternions in representing rotations and postures, we propose a quaternion-valued supervised learning Hopfield-structured neural network (QSHNN) with a fully connected structure inspired by the classic Hopfield neural network (HNN). Starting from a continuous-time dynamical model of HNNs, we extend the formulation to the quaternionic domain and establish the existence and uniqueness of fixed points with asymptotic stability. For the learning rules, we introduce a periodic projection strategy that modifies standard gradient descent by periodically projecting each 4*4 block of the weight matrix onto the closest quaternionic structure in the least-squares sense. This approach preserves both convergence and quaternionic consistency throughout training. Benefiting from this rigorous mathematical foundation, the experimental model implementation achieves high accuracy, fast convergence, and strong reliability across randomly generated target sets. Moreover, the evolution trajectories of the QSHNN exhibit well-bounded curvature, i.e., sufficient smoothness, which is crucial for applications such as control systems or path planning modules in robotic arms, where joint postures are parameterized by quaternion neurons. Beyond these application scenarios, the proposed model offers a practical implementation framework and a general mathematical methodology for designing neural networks under hypercomplex or non-commutative algebraic structures.

title: Structured Debate Improves Corporate Credit Reasoning in Financial AI
summary: This study investigated LLM-based automation for analyzing non-financial data in corporate credit evaluation. Two systems were developed and compared: a Single-Agent System (SAS), in which one LLM agent infers favorable and adverse repayment signals, and a Popperian Multi-agent Debate System (PMADS), which structures the dual-perspective analysis as adversarial argumentation under the Karl Popper Debate protocol. Evaluation addressed three fronts: (i) work productivity compared with human experts; (ii) perceived report quality and usability, rated by credit risk professionals for system-generated reports; and (iii) reasoning characteristics quantified via reasoning-tree analysis. Both systems drastically reduced task completion time relative to human experts. Professionals rated SAS reports as adequate, while PMADS reports exceeded neutral benchmarks and scored significantly higher in explanatory adequacy, practical applicability, and usability. Reasoning-tree analysis showed PMADS produced deeper, more elaborated structures, whereas SAS yielded single-layered trees. These findings suggest that structured multi-agent debate enhances analytical rigor and perceived usefulness, though at the cost of longer computation time. Overall, the results demonstrate that reasoning-centered automation represents a promising approach for developing useful AI systems in decision-critical financial contexts.

title: How role-play shapes relevance judgment in zero-shot LLM rankers
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as promising zero-shot rankers, but their performance is highly sensitive to prompt formulation. In particular, role-play prompts, where the model is assigned a functional role or identity, often give more robust and accurate relevance rankings. However, the mechanisms and diversity of role-play effects remain underexplored, limiting both effective use and interpretability. In this work, we systematically examine how role-play variations influence zero-shot LLM rankers. We employ causal intervention techniques from mechanistic interpretability to trace how role-play information shapes relevance judgments in LLMs. Our analysis reveals that (1) careful formulation of role descriptions have a large effect on the ranking quality of the LLM; (2) role-play signals are predominantly encoded in early layers and communicate with task instructions in middle layers, while receiving limited interaction with query or document representations. Specifically, we identify a group of attention heads that encode information critical for role-conditioned relevance. These findings not only shed light on the inner workings of role-play in LLM ranking but also offer guidance for designing more effective prompts in IR and beyond, pointing toward broader opportunities for leveraging role-play in zero-shot applications.

title: Numerical Error Analysis of the Poisson Equation under RHS Inaccuracies in Particle-in-Cell Simulations
summary: Particle-in-Cell (PIC) simulations rely on accurate solutions of the electrostatic Poisson equation, yet accuracy often deteriorates near irregular Dirichlet boundaries on Cartesian meshes. While much research has addressed discretization errors on the left-hand side (LHS) of the Poisson equation, the impact of right-hand-side (RHS) inaccuracies - arising from charge density sampling near boundaries in PIC methods - remains largely unexplored. This study analyzes the numerical errors induced by underestimated RHS values at near-boundary nodes when solving the Poisson equation using embedded boundary finite difference schemes with linear and quadratic treatments. Analytical derivations in one dimension and truncation error analyses in two dimensions reveal that such RHS inaccuracies modify local truncation behavior differently: they reduce the dominant truncation error in the linear scheme but introduce a zeroth-order term in the quadratic scheme, leading to larger global errors. Numerical experiments in one-, two-, and three-dimensional domains confirm these findings. Contrary to expectations, the linear scheme yields superior overall accuracy under typical PIC-induced RHS inaccuracies. A simple RHS calibration strategy is further proposed to restore the accuracy of the quadratic scheme. These results offer new insight into the interplay between boundary-induced RHS errors and discretization accuracy in Poisson-type problems.

title: An Adaptive Neuro-Controller Developed for a Prosthetic Hand Wrist
summary: The significance of employing a controller in prosthetic hands cannot be overstated, as it plays a crucial role in enhancing the functionality and usability of these systems. This paper introduces an adaptive neuro-controller specifically developed for a tendon-driven soft continuum wrist of a prosthetic hand. Kinematic and dynamic modeling of the wrist is carried out using the Timoshenko beam theory. A Neural Network (NN) based strategy is adopted to predict the required motor currents to manipulate the wrist tendons from the errors in the deflection of the wrist section. The Timoshenko beam theory is used to compute the required tendon tension from the input motor current. A comparison of the adaptive neuro-controller with other similar controllers is conducted to analyze the performance of the proposed approach. Simulation studies and experimental validations of the fabricated wrist are included to demonstrate the effectiveness of the controller.

title: On the Sample Complexity of Differentially Private Policy Optimization
summary: Policy optimization (PO) is a cornerstone of modern reinforcement learning (RL), with diverse applications spanning robotics, healthcare, and large language model training. The increasing deployment of PO in sensitive domains, however, raises significant privacy concerns. In this paper, we initiate a theoretical study of differentially private policy optimization, focusing explicitly on its sample complexity. We first formalize an appropriate definition of differential privacy (DP) tailored to PO, addressing the inherent challenges arising from on-policy learning dynamics and the subtlety involved in defining the unit of privacy. We then systematically analyze the sample complexity of widely-used PO algorithms, including policy gradient (PG), natural policy gradient (NPG) and more, under DP constraints and various settings, via a unified framework. Our theoretical results demonstrate that privacy costs can often manifest as lower-order terms in the sample complexity, while also highlighting subtle yet important observations in private PO settings. These offer valuable practical insights for privacy-preserving PO algorithms.

title: Macro-element Refinement schemes for THB-Splines: Applications to Bézier Projection and Structure-Preserving Discretizations
summary: This paper introduces a novel adaptive refinement strategy for Isogeometric Analysis (IGA) using Truncated Hierarchical B-splines (THB-splines). The proposed strategy enhances locally-refined meshes for specific applications, simplifying implementation. We focus on two key applications: an $L^2$-stable local projector for THB-splines via Bézier projection [Dijkstra and Toshniwal (2023)], and structure-preserving discretizations using THB-splines [Evans et al. (2020), Shepherd and Toshniwal (2024)]. Previous methods required mesh modifications to retain crucial properties like local linear independence and the exactness of discrete de Rham complexes. Our approach introduces a macro-element-based refinement technique, refining $\vec{q} = q_1\times\cdots\times q_n$ blocks of elements, termed $\vec{q}$-boxes, where the block size $\vec{q}$ is determined by the spline degree and application. For the Bézier projection, we refine $\vec{p}$-boxes (i.e., $\vec{q} = \vec{p}$), ensuring THB-splines are locally linearly independent in these boxes, which enables a straightforward extension of the Bézier projection algorithm, greatly improving upon Dijkstra and Toshniwal (2023). For structure-preserving discretizations, we refine $(\vec{p+1})$-boxes (i.e., $\vec{q} = \vec{p}+\vec{1}$), demonstrating that this choice meets the sufficient conditions for ensuring the exactness of the THB-spline de Rham complex, as outlined by Shepherd and Toshniwal (2024), in any dimension. This critical aspect allows for adaptive simulations without additional mesh modifications. The effectiveness of our framework is supported by theoretical proofs and numerical experiments, including optimal convergence for adaptive approximation and simulations of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.

title: GSAlign: Geometric and Semantic Alignment Network for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
summary: Aerial-Ground person re-identification (AG-ReID) is an emerging yet challenging task that aims to match pedestrian images captured from drastically different viewpoints, typically from unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and ground-based surveillance cameras. The task poses significant challenges due to extreme viewpoint discrepancies, occlusions, and domain gaps between aerial and ground imagery. While prior works have made progress by learning cross-view representations, they remain limited in handling severe pose variations and spatial misalignment. To address these issues, we propose a Geometric and Semantic Alignment Network (GSAlign) tailored for AG-ReID. GSAlign introduces two key components to jointly tackle geometric distortion and semantic misalignment in aerial-ground matching: a Learnable Thin Plate Spline (LTPS) Module and a Dynamic Alignment Module (DAM). The LTPS module adaptively warps pedestrian features based on a set of learned keypoints, effectively compensating for geometric variations caused by extreme viewpoint changes. In parallel, the DAM estimates visibility-aware representation masks that highlight visible body regions at the semantic level, thereby alleviating the negative impact of occlusions and partial observations in cross-view correspondence. A comprehensive evaluation on CARGO with four matching protocols demonstrates the effectiveness of GSAlign, achieving significant improvements of +18.8\% in mAP and +16.8\% in Rank-1 accuracy over previous state-of-the-art methods on the aerial-ground setting.

title: SemiETPicker: Fast and Label-Efficient Particle Picking for CryoET Tomography Using Semi-Supervised Learning
comments: IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2026
summary: Cryogenic Electron Tomography (CryoET) combined with sub-volume averaging (SVA) is the only imaging modality capable of resolving protein structures inside cells at molecular resolution. Particle picking, the task of localizing and classifying target proteins in 3D CryoET volumes, remains the main bottleneck. Due to the reliance on time-consuming manual labels, the vast reserve of unlabeled tomograms remains underutilized. In this work, we present a fast, label-efficient semi-supervised framework that exploits this untapped data. Our framework consists of two components: (i) an end-to-end heatmap-supervised detection model inspired by keypoint detection, and (ii) a teacher-student co-training mechanism that enhances performance under sparse labeling conditions. Furthermore, we introduce multi-view pseudo-labeling and a CryoET-specific DropBlock augmentation strategy to further boost performance. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale CZII dataset show that our approach improves F1 by 10% over supervised baselines, underscoring the promise of semi-supervised learning for leveraging unlabeled CryoET data.

title: Learning "Partner-Aware" Collaborators in Multi-Party Collaboration
comments: Fixed typographic errors in the previous manuscript
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in agentic settings where they act as collaborators with humans. Therefore, it is increasingly important to be able to evaluate their abilities to collaborate effectively in multi-turn, multi-party tasks. In this paper, we build on the AI alignment and safe interruptibility literature to offer novel theoretical insights on collaborative behavior between LLM-driven collaborator agents and an intervention agent. Our goal is to learn an ideal partner-aware collaborator that increases the group's common-ground (CG) alignment on task-relevant propositions-by intelligently collecting information provided in interventions by a partner agent. We show how LLM agents trained using standard RLHF and related approaches are naturally inclined to ignore possibly well-meaning interventions, which makes increasing group common ground non-trivial in this setting. We employ a two-player Modified-Action MDP to examine this suboptimal behavior of standard AI agents, and propose Interruptible Collaborative Roleplayer (ICR)-a novel partner-aware learning algorithm to train CG-optimal collaborators. Experiments on multiple collaborative task environments show that ICR, on average, is more capable of promoting successful CG convergence and exploring more diverse solutions in such tasks.

title: MDReID: Modality-Decoupled Learning for Any-to-Any Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
summary: Real-world object re-identification (ReID) systems often face modality inconsistencies, where query and gallery images come from different sensors (e.g., RGB, NIR, TIR). However, most existing methods assume modality-matched conditions, which limits their robustness and scalability in practical applications. To address this challenge, we propose MDReID, a flexible any-to-any image-level ReID framework designed to operate under both modality-matched and modality-mismatched scenarios. MDReID builds on the insight that modality information can be decomposed into two components: modality-shared features that are predictable and transferable, and modality-specific features that capture unique, modality-dependent characteristics. To effectively leverage this, MDReID introduces two key components: the Modality Decoupling Learning (MDL) and Modality-aware Metric Learning (MML). Specifically, MDL explicitly decomposes modality features into modality-shared and modality-specific representations, enabling effective retrieval in both modality-aligned and mismatched scenarios. MML, a tailored metric learning strategy, further enforces orthogonality and complementarity between the two components to enhance discriminative power across modalities. Extensive experiments conducted on three challenging multi-modality ReID benchmarks (RGBNT201, RGBNT100, MSVR310) consistently demonstrate the superiority of MDReID. Notably, MDReID achieves significant mAP improvements of 9.8\%, 3.0\%, and 11.5\% in general modality-matched scenarios, and average gains of 3.4\%, 11.8\%, and 10.9\% in modality-mismatched scenarios, respectively. The code is available at: \textcolor{magenta}{https://github.com/stone96123/MDReID}.

title: QueryIPI: Query-agnostic Indirect Prompt Injection on Coding Agents
summary: Modern coding agents integrated into IDEs orchestrate powerful tools and high-privilege system access, creating a high-stakes attack surface. Prior work on Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) is mainly query-specific, requiring particular user queries as triggers and leading to poor generalizability. We propose query-agnostic IPI, a new attack paradigm that reliably executes malicious payloads under arbitrary user queries. Our key insight is that malicious payloads should leverage the invariant prompt context (i.e., system prompt and tool descriptions) rather than variant user queries. We present QueryIPI, an automated framework that uses tool descriptions as optimizable payloads and refines them via iterative, prompt-based blackbox optimization. QueryIPI leverages system invariants for initial seed generation aligned with agent conventions, and iterative reflection to resolve instruction-following failures and safety refusals. Experiments on five simulated agents show that QueryIPI achieves up to 87% success rate, outperforming the best baseline (50%). Crucially, generated malicious descriptions transfer to real-world coding agents, highlighting a practical security risk.

title: ToolRM: Towards Agentic Tool-Use Reward Modeling
summary: Reward models (RMs) play a critical role in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. Yet in the domain of tool learning, the lack of RMs specifically designed for function-calling tasks has limited progress toward more capable agentic AI. We introduce ToolRM, a family of lightweight reward models tailored for general tool-use scenarios. To build these models, we propose a novel pipeline that constructs high-quality pairwise preference data using rule-based scoring and multidimensional sampling. This yields ToolPref-Pairwise-30K, a diverse, balanced, and challenging preference dataset that supports both generative and discriminative reward modeling. We also introduce TRBench$_{BFCL}$, a benchmark built on the agent evaluation suite BFCL to evaluate RMs on tool calling tasks. Trained on our constructed data, models from the Qwen3-4B/8B series achieve up to 17.94% higher accuracy, substantially outperforming frontier LLMs and RMs in pairwise reward judgments. Beyond training objectives, generative ToolRM generalizes to broader critique tasks, including Best-of-N sampling and self-correction. Experiments on ACEBench highlight its effectiveness and efficiency, enabling inference-time scaling while reducing output token usage by over 66%. Its support for downstream RL training further validates its practical utility. We release data to facilitate future research.

title: LLM generation novelty through the lens of semantic similarity
summary: Generation novelty is a key indicator of an LLM's ability to generalize, yet measuring it against full pretraining corpora is computationally challenging. Existing evaluations often rely on lexical overlap, failing to detect paraphrased text, or do not consider the full pretraining corpus. We frame novelty as a semantic retrieval problem. This framing enables us to address novelty with modern embedding and indexing pipelines, allowing for efficient analysis at pre-training scale. Specifically, we propose a three-stage framework that retrieves semantically similar samples, reranks them at varying subsequence lengths, and calibrates scores using a human novelty reference for interpretability. We apply this framework to the SmolLM model family and report three key findings: (1) models draw on pre-training data across much longer sequences than previously reported; (2) some task domains systematically promote or suppress generation novelty; and (3) instruction tuning not only alters style but also increases novelty. These results highlight the value of semantic novelty analysis for studying generalization. To support reproducibility and further research, we release ~20 TB of corpus chunks and index artifacts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/stai-tuebingen/faiss-smollm

title: Robust Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Regional Traffic Signal Control Under Demand Fluctuations
comments: A critical error in the methodology. The reported congestion control effects were not caused by the proposed signal timing optimization, but by an incorrect traffic volume scaling factor during evaluation. The traffic demand was not properly amplified, resulting in misleading performance gains. Due to the substantial nature of the error, completion of revisions is not feasible in the short term
summary: Traffic congestion, primarily driven by intersection queuing, significantly impacts urban living standards, safety, environmental quality, and economic efficiency. While Traffic Signal Control (TSC) systems hold potential for congestion mitigation, traditional optimization models often fail to capture real-world traffic complexity and dynamics. This study introduces a novel single-agent reinforcement learning (RL) framework for regional adaptive TSC, circumventing the coordination complexities inherent in multi-agent systems through a centralized decision-making paradigm. The model employs an adjacency matrix to unify the encoding of road network topology, real-time queue states derived from probe vehicle data, and current signal timing parameters. Leveraging the efficient learning capabilities of the DreamerV3 world model, the agent learns control policies where actions sequentially select intersections and adjust their signal phase splits to regulate traffic inflow/outflow, analogous to a feedback control system. Reward design prioritizes queue dissipation, directly linking congestion metrics (queue length) to control actions. Simulation experiments conducted in SUMO demonstrate the model's effectiveness: under inference scenarios with multi-level (10%, 20%, 30%) Origin-Destination (OD) demand fluctuations, the framework exhibits robust anti-fluctuation capability and significantly reduces queue lengths. This work establishes a new paradigm for intelligent traffic control compatible with probe vehicle technology. Future research will focus on enhancing practical applicability by incorporating stochastic OD demand fluctuations during training and exploring regional optimization mechanisms for contingency events.

summary: Several studies have employed reinforcement learning (RL) to address the challenges of regional adaptive traffic signal control (ATSC) and achieved promising results. In this field, existing research predominantly adopts multi-agent frameworks. However, the adoption of multi-agent frameworks presents challenges for scalability. Instead, the Traffic signal control (TSC) problem necessitates a single-agent framework. TSC inherently relies on centralized management by a single control center, which can monitor traffic conditions across all roads in the study area and coordinate the control of all intersections. This work proposes a single-agent RL-based regional ATSC model compatible with probe vehicle technology. Key components of the RL design include state, action, and reward function definitions. To facilitate learning and manage congestion, both state and reward functions are defined based on queue length, with action designed to regulate queue dynamics. The queue length definition used in this study differs slightly from conventional definitions but is closely correlated with congestion states. More importantly, it allows for reliable estimation using link travel time data from probe vehicles. With probe vehicle data already covering most urban roads, this feature enhances the proposed method's potential for widespread deployment. The method was comprehensively evaluated using the SUMO simulation platform. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model effectively mitigates large-scale regional congestion levels via coordinated multi-intersection control.
